DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with concurrent Ovarian Cyst.

The ultrasound confirms a thickened endometrial stripe, which is the direct cause of your postmenopausal bleeding, alongside a left adnexal mass which appears benign given your lack of severe symptoms. We will proceed with an endometrial biopsy to rule out hyperplasia-associated malignancy.
